lesson: When win/loss shows losses concentrated below a price band, the low end is over-priced for its value while feature-gated capabilities (e.g. SSO, audit logs) are under-monetized at the top. Re-tiering to add a lighter entry plan plus a feature-gated upper tier can lift both win rate and ACV while holding margin.
evidence: Worked example modeling, survey n=180 + 31 win/loss data points
